answer: Each submission hangs on the delta of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
